description: Browse rows of one table with pagination and optional sorting — a quick read-only alternative to hand-writing a SELECT.
name: vibekit_db_table

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Rows from the requested table with pagination applied.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Browse Table
